name: How does framing coordinate with plumbing and electrical rough-ins?

mainEntity.name: How does framing coordinate with plumbing and electrical rough-ins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing provides the structural foundation for all mechanical systems, requiring coordinated framing layouts so HVAC ducts, plumbing stacks, and electrical runs fit without compromising structural integrity. Owner Abraham Becerra manages this process directly, coordinating sub-trades for electrical and plumbing right after the rough wood framing is finished. Drill holes and notches in floor joists and load-bearing studs must follow strict code guidelines to maintain lumber strength. Once trades finish pulling wire and pipe, our in-house crew takes over to insulate, hang drywall, and complete finish carpentry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing leaves designated chase spaces for pipes and wiring. Once rough framing is complete, sub-trades run mechanicals before any insulation or drywall is installed.
